role: One 8x8x8-chunk bucket of GL display lists in RenderGlobal's old render-list system: it records which lists to call for a chunk position and replays them with a camera-relative translate.
scope_reason: Part of the compared frame's draw path, but its job (camera-relative replay of section geometry) is done by the live pipeline's direct draw.

members.name: renderChunkX
members.note: bucket position; the live pipeline addresses sections by chunk coords directly

members.name: cameraX
members.note: the camera offset is applied per vertex in raster.c clip_triangle's modelview stage

members.name: glLists
members.note: GL display list ids; native emits vertices, not lists

members.name: setupRenderList
members.note: bucket setup of the GL list era

members.name: callLists
members.note: replaying a bucket of lists becomes drawing the section's recorded triangles in order (live_draw_section); the GL glCallLists stream is not reproduced

notes: This class is only reachable through RenderGlobal's renderAllRenderLists; the live pipeline never builds GL lists. Status partial because the behaviour it provided (camera-relative replay of section geometry in order) exists, but no member maps to a named C function. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data. Formerly listed as missing: No member has a symbol-level counterpart: the whole GL render-list system is replaced by raster.c's direct triangle pipeline (SPEC: GL is the numerical oracle, not something we emit). The observable draw order and geometry are preserved by live_draw_section.
